Our Methodology

A rigorous 4-step framework guaranteeing assessment integrity and precision across the nation.

01

1. Need Analysis

Analyzing NOS (National Occupational Standards) to craft a customized bank of 35,000+ localized questions.

02

2. Deployment

Utilizing our flawless TAGSCORE platform via online surveillance or offline tablet synchronization.

03

3. Invigilation

Deployment of 500+ certified assessors ensuring strict adherence to NCVET compliance and protocols.

04

4. Certification

Data-driven processing for instant results, candidate gap analysis, and uncompromising final certification.
